partners.mechanism_chain: CYBA (HGNC:2405) —DISRUPTS→ NADPH oxidase complex assembly and activation (GO:0032907); PIK3R1 (HGNC:9479) —DISRUPTS→ NADPH oxidase complex assembly and activation (GO:0032907); NADPH oxidase complex assembly and activation (GO:0032907) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent infections (HP:0002719); NADPH oxidase complex assembly and activation (GO:0032907) —LEADS_TO→ Granuloma formation (HP:0002719); NADPH oxidase complex assembly and activation (GO:0032907) —LEADS_TO→ Lymphoproliferation (HP:0002719). Loss-of-function mutations in CYBA directly impair the function of the NADPH oxidase complex. Loss-of-function mutations in PIK3R1 disrupt the PI3K signaling pathway, which is essential for the proper activation and assembly of the NADPH oxidase complex. Both disruptions converge on the dysregulation of the NADPH oxidase complex, leading to impaired phagocyte function and recurrent infections. Granulomatous disease is characterized by impaired microbial killing and granuloma formation, while immunodeficiency 36 with lymphoproliferation also presents with recurrent infections and abnormal immune cell proliferation due to the defective innate immune response.

partners.mechanism_chain: CYBA (HGNC:2405) —DISRUPTS→ NADPH oxidase complex assembly and function (GO:0032089); NCKAP1L (HGNC:29917) —DISRUPTS→ NADPH oxidase complex assembly and function (GO:0032089); NADPH oxidase complex assembly and function (GO:0032089) —LEADS_TO→ Chronic granulomatous disease (HP:0002713); NADPH oxidase complex assembly and function (GO:0032089) —LEADS_TO→ Autoinflammation (HP:0011373); NADPH oxidase complex assembly and function (GO:0032089) —LEADS_TO→ Immunodeficiency (HP:0002705). Loss-of-function mutations in CYBA (encoding the p22-phox subunit) and NCKAP1L (involved in regulating NADPH oxidase assembly) both disrupt the function of the NADPH oxidase complex. This complex is crucial for producing reactive oxygen species (ROS) necessary for phagocyte killing of pathogens. Impaired ROS production leads to recurrent infections and granuloma formation characteristic of chronic granulomatous disease. Furthermore, dysregulation of the NADPH oxidase complex and subsequent inflammatory signaling contributes to the autoinflammation seen in immunodeficiency 72.

partners.mechanism_chain: CYBA (HGNC:2430) —DISRUPTS→ NADPH oxidase complex activity (GO:0004594); NADPH oxidase complex activity (GO:0004594) —LEADS_TO→ Impaired neutrophil function (HP:0002705); PIK3R1 (HGNC:9307) —DISRUPTS→ PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (KEGG:hsa04150); PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (KEGG:hsa04150) —DECREASES→ MAPK signaling pathway (KEGG:hsa04010); MAPK signaling pathway (KEGG:hsa04010) —LEADS_TO→ Short stature (HP:0004325); MAPK signaling pathway (KEGG:hsa04010) —LEADS_TO→ Lipodystrophy (HP:0001049). Loss-of-function mutations in CYBA impair the NADPH oxidase complex, leading to reduced ROS production and impaired neutrophil function in granulomatous disease. In SHORT syndrome, loss-of-function mutations in PIK3R1 lead to decreased PI3K signaling, which in turn dysregulates downstream pathways including the MAPK signaling pathway. Dysregulation of the MAPK pathway contributes to the short stature and lipodystrophy phenotypes of SHORT syndrome. The overlap arises from the shared influence on downstream signaling pathways, with PI3K signaling being a known modulator of inflammatory responses and cellular functions that can intersect with pathways regulated by NADPH oxidase activity.

Furthermore, clarifying the specific downstream consequences of these defects can guide targeted treatments for infections and lymphoproliferation.
